test_texture_modder: test the TextureModder class by applying random checkerboard and gradient textures to MuJoCo geometry objects
test_material_modder: test the MaterialModder class by setting specularity, reflectance, and shininess properties on MuJoCo geometries
test_texture_modder_whiten: test the TextureModder whiten_materials method to reset all geometry textures to white before applying new colors
test_texture_modder_set_rgb: test the TextureModder set_rgb method to apply solid RGB colors to named MuJoCo geometry objects
test_multiple_sims_modder: test that TextureModder produces consistent renderings across multiple MuJoCo simulator instances with the same random seed
